constraint: Must maintain spinal fusion device function within clinical specifications
mechanism: Corrosion resistance through material selection and surface modifications to balance mechanical strength and biological integration.
intervention: Apply a bioactive surface treatment or porous coating (e.g., titanium alloy with a corrosion-resistant coating) to the spinal fusion device components.
expected_effect: Reduced corrosion and maintained mechanical integrity, ensuring device function within clinical specifications over long-term implantation.
falsification_test: Immerse the modified device in simulated body fluid (e.g., Ringer's solution) at 37°C for 6 months; measure corrosion rate via weight loss and surface analysis, and verify mechanical performance (e.g., fatigue strength) remains within ASTM F1717 standards.
